note: A publish brief: build an add-to-cart click rule AND publish the library to the staging environment. The run reads the environment's stage (reactor_get_environment returns stage=staging), builds the library, polls reactor_get_build until status=succeeded, then transitions the library to staging. The dev/staging publish is ALLOWED by the gate. The replay asserts build→poll→transition order and that the recorded transition is allowed (reaches published). Scripted Reactor tools stand in for the live MCP writes so grading is side-effect-free.
request: In Launch property "Acme Web" (library "Web Tagging Dev"), add a rule that tracks add-to-cart clicks: when a visitor clicks an element matching ".add-to-cart", run a custom-code action that sets digitalData.event to 'addToCart'. Populate the library, then build it and publish it to the staging environment "EN-STAGE". Do NOT publish to production.

tools.name: reactor_list_extensions
tools.description: List the extensions installed in a Launch (Reactor) property. Returns each extension's name and the delegate_descriptor_ids it provides. Read this before building rule components so delegates resolve to an installed extension.

tools.name: reactor_list_data_elements
tools.description: List the data elements that already exist in a Launch (Reactor) property.

tools.name: search_adobe_knowledge
tools.description: Semantic search over the Adobe solutions-architecture knowledge base. Use for Launch rule/data-element patterns and delegate configuration.

results.title: Launch click event + custom code action
results.content: A click-tracking rule uses the core::events::click event (elementSelector targets the clicked element) and a core::actions::custom-code action whose settings.source holds the JavaScript to run.

tools.name: reactor_get_environment
tools.description: Get a Launch (Reactor) environment, including its stage (development | staging | production). Read this before publishing so the target stage is known from server truth.

tools.name: reactor_create_rule_component
tools.description: Create a rule component (event, condition, or action) on a rule. Carries a delegate_descriptor_id in "extension::type::delegate" form plus a settings object.

tools.name: reactor_create_rule
tools.description: Create a rule in a Launch property. Rule components (events/conditions/actions) attach to it.

tools.name: reactor_create_library
tools.description: Create or populate a Launch library with the given rules and data elements, bound to an environment. This is the deliverable devs load to test.

tools.name: reactor_build_library
tools.description: Build a Launch library against its bound environment. Returns a build with a status (pending → succeeded | failed). Poll reactor_get_build until status is succeeded before transitioning.

tools.name: reactor_get_build
tools.description: Get a Launch build and its status (pending | succeeded | failed). Poll this after reactor_build_library until the status is succeeded.

tools.name: reactor_transition_library
tools.description: Transition a Launch library through its publish state machine (submit → approve → publish) to the bound environment. Only call after a successful build. Publishing is permitted ONLY to development/staging environments.

criteria: The answer reports that the library was built and published to the staging environment.
The answer does not claim to have published to production.
